decisions.reason: Locates inject:["apiProxy"] and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers() plus the dead dsh-host-apiproxy dependency, but never maps to A1-01 (openly declines card IDs) and does not explain the llm injection/listProviders replacement path.

Accounts for all six other categories with per-file scan evidence; clears session-notes.js as a pure utility and treats cordis.patch.yml as ordinary composition without denying its existence or inventing coupling.
Explains absence-of-evidence limits (no transitive/runtime visibility, unverified pinned dependency) and separates the one decisive apiProxy break from the six negative categories.
Proposes build/typecheck against 0.1.2 types, an isolated-profile cold boot, and an actual providers call as checks to run, not as executed.
